description:
GeForce NOW connects to digital PC game stores so you can stream the library of games you already own

GeForce NOW instantly transforms nearly any laptop, desktop, Mac, SHIELD TV, Android device, iPhone, or iPad into the PC gaming rig you’ve always dreamed of.
Play the most demanding PC games and seamlessly play across your devices.
GeForce NOW Gets a Fresh New Look
- The GeForce NOW app has a new look with a modern, glass-inspired design, rounded corners, and improved navigation. Game titles now appear beneath each game tile that makes it easier to browse your library and discover games. The refreshed design also extends to the in-game overlay.
Resume Your Game Session on Another Device
- Want to quickly move your game session from your PC to your TV or phone? Games still running on another device are now easier to find and resume so you can pick up right where you left off without having to relaunch the game.
Easier Account Management
- You can now access the option to delete your NVIDIA account directly from the GeForce NOW app. Looking to update your membership instead? You can also find a link to manage your subscription.
Bug Fixes
- General stability and performance improvements.
What’s on Your Mind?
- Tell us about your streaming session, or what games you want to play, or suggest improvements we can make. Use the help icon to send feedback in the app and let us know what you think.
